title: Not impressed. A waste of money. Rotisserie quits working before food is done.
text:
Not impressed. A waste of money. Rotisserie quits working before food is done.. This Air Fryer Toaster Oven is messy. I had another air fryer and it quit working. I thought this looked like a good one. I was wrong. I cooked some meat, I put it on the setting for steak. The problem I have with this fryer is when I turned the meat to cook the other side drippings from the meat got all over the fryer door. I was not happy.

Revised: I tried to pop some popcorn in the cage which is used on the rotisserie. The whole oven turned off twice. I am so happy it was popcorn and not a whole chicken.

The box comes with an air fryer. It also has a rack, a basket with remover, a drip pan, a rolling cage, and a rotisseries fork. It also comes with a very basic manual. No instructions for the amount of popcorn or fries, the default times don’t give you weight or size. Not impressed.

I will not be recommending this Air Fryer Toaster Oven to family and friends. I have actually ordered a different fryer.
